answers.core: Because Godot's nature is already based on plug'n'play principles that I am striving towards. Plus, I don't want developers to handicap themselves by using our API just to load their assets. I already implemented this in Unity and I already implemented this in UE4, and It works as expected.
answers.workaround: This needs to be done externally, so developers on their end won't have to write initialization code to hook up their own asset library.
